plan: A barbarian who hits harder and harder and can't die for a few seconds thanks to his ultimate.
aSurveiller: His R (Undying Rage). For 5 seconds he can't die: back off and wait for it to end to kill him.
contrer: When he casts his R, back off: he can't die, but he becomes mortal again right after.
Buy a Grievous Wounds item: he heals with his Q at the end of his R.
Slow him: he only has one movement spell (E) to reach you.
forces: Huge damage with his critical strikes.
faiblesses: Only one mobility spell: his E.

sorts.P: Gains fury by attacking: more critical strikes.
sorts.Q: More damage when wounded; heals with his fury.
sorts.W: Reduces nearby enemies' damage; slows those facing away.
sorts.E: Dashes and damages along the way.

momentFort.voie: Strong from level 6, and very dangerous in the late game.
momentFort.jungle: Slow to reach level 3, he farms for his items. Invade him early before he becomes dangerous.
